name: global-radio
description: 全球电台 - 聆听世界

scripts.electron:dev: npm run build && tsc -p electron/tsconfig.json && electron dist-electron/main.js
scripts.electron:build: npm run build && tsc -p electron/tsconfig.json && electron-builder
scripts.electron:build:win: npm run build && tsc -p electron/tsconfig.json && electron-builder --win --x64
scripts.build:android: npm run build && npx cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease
